expectations.text: 图片生成用 Agent Plan 入口 /api/plan/v3/images/generations 与 Model Name doubao-seedream-5.0-lite
expectations.evidence: generate.py: DEFAULT_BASE_URL = 'https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3'; DEFAULT_IMAGE_MODEL = 'doubao-seedream-4-0-250828'. NOTES.md asserts 'Agent Plan 的 Key 也是同一格式，套餐权益绑定在账号/Key 上，而不是靠不同的 URL 区分'. Ground truth A1: an Agent Plan Key on /api/v3 returns 401 {"error":{"code":"AuthenticationError","message":"The API key or AK/SK in the request is missing or invalid. ..."}}. Because ArkError.is_entitlement is true for 401, generate_one() re-raises and main() aborts with exit code 2 on the very first prompt: zero images are produced. Wrong entry, wrong model (a dated standard Model ID, not the Plan Model Name), wrong size ('1K' would be 400 on the real Plan image model).

expectations.text: 明确指出 Medium 套餐不支持视频生成模型（视频仅 Large / Max 档），而不是直接写视频代码假定能跑
expectations.evidence: NOTES.md only hedges: '视频（Seedance）大概率不在套餐内 … 据我所知一般不放进订阅套餐额度，而是按量付费' and '我无法在没有 Key 的情况下查询你账号的实际权益'. It never states that Medium lacks video or that video is Large/Max only; it frames video as a pay-as-you-go add-on. The code assumes it might run and relies on runtime detection, but ENTITLEMENT_CODES = {ModelNotOpen, ModelNotFound, AccountOverdueError, QuotaExceeded, AccessDenied, AuthenticationError, InvalidEndpointOrModel} does not include UnsupportedModel and is_entitlement only treats 401/403 status as entitlement, so the real Medium response (404 UnsupportedModel, ground truth B10) would be logged as 'video failed' with exit code 1 instead of the promised graceful 'unavailable' skip.

expectations.text: 如给出视频代码，采用创建任务 + 轮询 GET /contents/generations/tasks/{id} 的异步模式
expectations.evidence: create_video_task(): self._request('POST', '/contents/generations/tasks', json=body); get_video_task(): self._request('GET', f'/contents/generations/tasks/{task_id}'); make_video() polls every 5 s until status in succeeded/failed/cancelled/expired and downloads content.video_url. The async pattern itself is correct even though the base URL and model (doubao-seedance-1-0-pro-250528) would never work with the user's Plan key.

expectations.text: 提到每张图消耗 99 AFP 或图片模型不受 5 小时 / 周限额约束、只受日 / 月限额
expectations.evidence: No mention of AFP anywhere in NOTES.md or generate.py. Pricing is given in RMB pay-as-you-go terms ('Seedream 4.0 约 0.2 元/张 1K 图量级'). On limits it states the opposite of the truth for images: '套餐 Key 通常按 5 小时/日 窗口限额、且有 RPM 上限' — the 5-hour window applies to text models, not image models.

claims.claim: Agent Plan key works on /api/v3; plan entitlement is bound to the key, not to a different URL
claims.evidence: Contradicted by verification-findings.md A1/A2 (401 AuthenticationError on /api/v3 and /api/coding/v3) and A3 (200 only on /api/plan/v3). Console text also says do not use /api/v3.

claims.claim: Seedream 4.0 (doubao-seedream-4-0-250828) accepts size '1K' and is the right model for Agent Plan quota
claims.evidence: 4.0 is a standard pay-as-you-go Model ID, not the Plan Model Name (doubao-seedream-5.0-lite). The Plan image model rejects '1K' with 400 (findings D). Even if 4.0 accepts 1K on /api/v3, the user cannot reach /api/v3 with a Plan key.

claims.claim: Script auto-detects video unavailability and downgrades gracefully (exit 0, status 'unavailable')
claims.evidence: The real Medium error is 404 UnsupportedModel (findings B10). is_entitlement checks code in ENTITLEMENT_CODES or status in (401, 403); neither matches, so the script would return exit code 1 with status 'failed'. Also unreachable in practice: the image stage aborts first on 401.

claims.claim: Plan keys are rate-limited by a 5-hour/daily window that applies to batch image generation
claims.evidence: Skill documentation (and the with_skill run) state image/video models are exempt from the 5-hour and weekly caps and only bound by daily/monthly AFP caps. Not directly probed in findings, but the baseline's claim is unsupported and contradicts the plan documentation.

claims.claim: Script was not executed against the real API
claims.evidence: NOTES.md header: '无 API Key，本脚本未做真实调用'.

claims.claim: Video model default doubao-seedance-1-0-pro-250528 supports image-to-video on this account
claims.evidence: Dated standard Model ID; Plan entry accepts Model Names and routes by name (findings B2/B6: old dated IDs -> 404 UnsupportedModel). On Medium any video model returns 404 regardless.

suggestions.reason: No assertion checks the size parameter, yet the prompt explicitly asks for '1K' and the real 5.0-lite rejects it with 400. Add an assertion that the output either avoids size '1K' on 5.0-lite or explains why 1K is unavailable.

suggestions.assertion: 如给出视频代码，采用创建任务 + 轮询 GET /contents/generations/tasks/{id} 的异步模式
suggestions.reason: This is the only assertion the baseline passed, and it passed with code that can never run for this user (wrong base URL, wrong model, and a 404 UnsupportedModel handler gap). Consider tightening it to require correct handling of 404 UnsupportedModel as 'plan lacks video'.

eval_feedback.overall: Three of four assertions discriminate well and all three exposed real production failures in the baseline. Assertion 3 is a near-freebie; the '1K' size trap is unasserted.
